description: This is a Java unit test class for the BookService in a book management application. It uses JUnit 5 and Mockito to test various methods of the BookService, including finding, saving, counting, and deleting books.

classes.name: BookServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing BookService methods using Mockito and JUnit 5. Includes setup and multiple test cases for various service functions.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes BookService with mocked dependencies before each test.

methods.name: findById_throwsException_ifIdIsNull
methods.description: Verifies that findById throws NullPointerException if given null.

methods.name: canFindByNonNullId
methods.description: Checks that findById calls the repository method when provided a valid ID.

methods.name: save_throwsException_ifBookIsNull
methods.description: Ensures save throws NullPointerException if the input book is null.

methods.name: save_returnsEmpty_ifBookDoesNotHaveAuthor
methods.description: Verifies that saving a book without an author returns an empty Optional and does not call save on repository.

methods.name: canSaveIfBookHasAuthorAndPredefinedShelf
methods.description: Test (currently disabled) that verifies saving a valid book with author and predefined shelf calls repository save.

methods.name: canCount
methods.description: Checks that the count method calls the repository's count.

methods.name: canFindAll
methods.description: Verifies findAll with pagination calls the repository's findAllBooks.

methods.name: findAll_searchesWithoutFilter_ifFilterIsNull
methods.description: Ensures that null filter defaults to a general find all.

methods.name: findAll_searchesWithoutFilter_ifFilterIsEmpty
methods.description: Ensures that empty filter defaults to a general find all.

methods.name: findAll_filtersByTitle_ifFilterIsNotNullOrEmpty
methods.description: Verifies that filtering by title calls the repository with the filter string.

methods.name: delete_throwsException_ifBookIsNull
methods.description: Ensures delete throws NullPointerException when input is null.

methods.name: canDeleteAll
methods.description: Checks that deleteAll calls the repository's deleteAll method.
